notes.title: New game mode and new particles
notes.content:
[b]System Update[/b]

Now you can look around using mouse


[b]New Game Mode "Box"[/b]

The ball shape change to box when you enter.

 - you can use grappling hook in the box map.



[b]New custom color option "Brightness"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41644509/014412d5e75db8817221621e4d5db2a5d1aeb3dc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41644509/c3fbc831fe516c4dd08144f28e76f0957f1e7679.png[/img]


[b]New Particles[/b]

You can get particles by finishing the map

notes.title: First update!!
notes.content:
[b]More Maps!![/b]
Before the update, there was only one  maps total, but I added two more maps in the game.



[b]More Particles!![/b]
There are 9 particles in total, you can get them by finishing the map, or finding easter eggs.


[b]UI Update[/b]

Fixed Ui. Now it look much better
[list]
[*]Setting Ui
[*]My Record Ui
[*]Pause Ui
[*]Main menu Ui
[/list]




[b]Bug Fixed[/b]
Now You can't die in pause, or when you finished the game


[b]Setting Update[/b]

New setting
    Added Resolution setting
    Low, Medium, High, Epic
